paper_innovations.name: Blockified Pattern for DiT Sparsity
paper_innovations.description: First observation that DiT attention sparsity exhibits hierarchical blockified structure rather than continuous patterns
paper_innovations.technical_details: Due to hierarchical modality structure (video-video, video-text, text-text), continuous patterns like col/diag fail. Blockified patterns achieve 0.93-1.0 recall vs 0.12-0.96 for continuous patterns
paper_innovations.runtime_impact: Get_Time(L, L, d) → Get_Time(L, L*(1-sparsity), d) for attention computation

paper_innovations.name: Fused LSE-Cached Online Search
paper_innovations.description: Two-phase search strategy leveraging LSE invariance across denoising steps
paper_innovations.technical_details: Phase 1: Fused online search (2-pass) computes FlashAttention + stores LSE. Phase 2: LSE-cached search (1-pass) reuses cached LSE, reducing search time by 50%
paper_innovations.runtime_impact: Get_Time(L, L, d) + Get_Time(L, L, d) → Get_Time(L, L, d) + Get_Time(L, L*0.05, d) for cached phases

paper_innovations.name: Head-adaptive Hierarchical Block Sparse Attention
paper_innovations.description: Per-head sparsity adjustment based on individual head recall performance
paper_innovations.technical_details: Sorts heads by recall, adjusts sparsity for top/bottom n heads while maintaining average sparsity. n = heads with recall > 0.8
paper_innovations.runtime_impact: Uniform: Get_Time(L, L*(1-s), d) → Adaptive: Σ_i Get_Time(L, L*(1-s_i), d) where s_i ∈ [(3s-1)/2, (1+s)/2]

paper_innovations.name: Training-free and Data-free Implementation
paper_innovations.description: First sparse attention method requiring no fine-tuning or dataset profiling
paper_innovations.technical_details: Plug-and-play via adaspa_attention_handler, single line code change, no additional training overhead
paper_innovations.runtime_impact: No additional Get_Time calls for training/profiling phases

proposed_improvements.name: Adaptive Sparsity Framework
proposed_improvements.description: Dynamic sparsity based on content complexity analysis
proposed_improvements.implementation: Motion magnitude + texture complexity → sparsity = f(complexity)

proposed_improvements.name: Multi-Scale Block Strategy
proposed_improvements.description: Hierarchical block sizes (32, 64, 128) based on attention entropy
proposed_improvements.implementation: Adaptive selection from {32,64,128} based on local attention patterns
proposed_improvements.runtime_impact: Σ_i Get_Time(L,L*(1-s),d) → Σ_i,j Get_Time(L,L*(1-s_j),d) with optimized block sizes

proposed_improvements.name: RL-Based Search Scheduling
proposed_improvements.description: Reinforcement learning for optimal search timing
proposed_improvements.runtime_impact: Fixed search overhead → Adaptive: Get_Time(L,L*0.05,d) → Get_Time(L,L*0.035,d)

proposed_improvements.name: Hardware-Aware Optimization
proposed_improvements.implementation: A100: current, RTX4090: reduced block size, Apple: Metal shaders

proposed_improvements.name: Temporal Consistency Enhancement
proposed_improvements.implementation: Optical flow → motion-guided block selection → temporal smoothing

proposed_improvements.name: Hybrid Precision Training
proposed_improvements.implementation: High precision: critical blocks, Low precision: sparse regions
